title: Doc2Harness: Benchmarking LLMs on Long-Horizon Harness Engineering of Coding Agents

paragraphs.en: Agents driven by large language models are increasingly deployed on long-horizon tasks, where they use tools and modify real workspaces. How well they perform depends as much on the harness around the model as on the model itself. Existing benchmarks measure downstream task success under a fixed harness, leaving harness engineering itself unexplored. We propose Doc2Harness, a two-stage benchmark that evaluates long-horizon harness engineering directly. In Stage 1, a build model operating inside a fixed builder harness receives an interface-only contract skeleton and a development document that consolidates behavior across twelve frontier harnesses, and then constructs a complete candidate harness in an isolated container. In Stage 2, the frozen candidate harness runs in containers separate from the construction environment, one per test case, and is driven end to end by a scripted mock model. We score each test case using four observable channels, namely the requests sent to the model, the files on disk, the process exit code, and the command output; positive controls rule out vacuous passes. Across nineteen frontier models, each evaluated with three independent builds on 328 test cases, GPT-6 Astra achieves the highest pass rate at 53.05%, while the weakest model reaches 27.44%, a gap of roughly twenty-six percentage points. Even the strongest model fails nearly half of the test cases, and failures cluster around how cross-cutting functionality is split across modules. To our knowledge, Doc2Harness provides the first deterministic benchmark for measuring long-horizon harness engineering.

paragraphs.en: As coding agents driven by large language models (LLMs) become more capable, they are deployed in increasingly complex settings ( Ge et al., 2025 ) . The harness therefore matters more: it manages the interaction loop, tool execution, context, permissions, session state, failure recovery, and result verification, and so determines how much of the model’s capability reaches the environment ( Mei et al., 2025 ) . At the same time, human supervision of every agent step has become difficult. This has motivated recursive self-improvement, in which an agent modifies the infrastructure that governs its own behavior. An agent executes a task, observes the outcome, modifies its own harness, and then uses the modified harness on the next task, improving itself over time. A model’s ability to generalize this process may ultimately determine the capability of the resulting agent.
paragraphs.zh: 随着由大型语言模型（LLM）驱动的编码智能体能力不断增强，它们正被部署到日益复杂的环境中（Ge 等人，2025）。 因此，约束机制变得更为关键：它管理着交互循环、工具执行、上下文、权限、会话状态、故障恢复和结果验证，从而决定了模型能力能在多大程度上作用于环境（Mei 等人，2025）。 与此同时，对智能体每一步操作进行人工监督已变得困难。 这推动了递归式自我改进机制，即智能体修改用于约束自身行为的底层架构。 智能体执行任务、观察结果、修改自身的约束机制，然后使用修改后的机制处理下一个任务，从而随着时间的推移不断提升自身能力。 模型能否将这一过程泛化，最终可能决定了所生成智能体的实际能力。

paragraphs.en: Building a harness is a type of software engineering (SWE) task, but it tests a kind of generalization that ordinary SWE tasks do not capture. At the data-source level, the open-source repositories used by SWE benchmarks are mostly mature projects that may have appeared repeatedly in training corpora. Harnesses, by contrast, have appeared only in the past few years and are updated at high frequency, so the resulting evaluation places greater emphasis on generalization. On the evaluation side, existing SWE benchmarks such as SWE-bench Pro ( Deng et al., 2026 ) , NL2Repo-Bench ( Ding et al., 2026 ) , and Commit0 ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) judge whether the model’s output is acceptable using the interactive unit tests supplied with the task. Such criteria do not transfer directly to harnesses, for two reasons. (1) A single feature can be realized in many ways inside a harness, whereas an ordinary unit test observes behavior through a fixed interface. (2) A harness does not complete a downstream task on its own, so its correctness must be assessed by driving it with a model.

paragraphs.en: We therefore propose Doc2Harness, a two-stage benchmark for evaluating how well LLMs develop harnesses. In Stage 1, the build model under evaluation operates inside a fixed builder harness and, given a development document and a contract skeleton that declares interfaces only, constructs a complete candidate harness inside an isolated container. In Stage 2, the candidate harness is moved into isolated containers, one per test case, launched and executed end to end as a black box, with a mock model providing responses according to a preset script and each test case running the harness through one complete session. We observe four channels for each test case, namely the requests sent to the model, the files on disk, the process exit code, and the command output, and aggregate the resulting statuses into a pass rate. The build model’s ability to develop a harness is reflected indirectly in the pass rate.

paragraphs.en: Both inputs are designed to reduce reliance on parametric knowledge that the build model may already possess: the development document is rewritten from the user documentation of twelve frontier harnesses after merging and disambiguation, and the contract skeleton is distilled further from mini-swe-agent ( Yang et al., 2024 ) with all internal implementation removed. A test case may pass even though the feature under test never ran, a situation we call a vacuous pass; to guard against it we introduce positive controls that verify the observation preconditions. If a positive control fails, the observation precondition is not satisfied, and the test case is recorded as FAIL regardless of its own status.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate nineteen frontier models and parse the source of every scored candidate harness. Higher-scoring candidate harnesses tend to place cross-cutting functionality in fewer modules. A model’s rank also moves by up to sixteen positions across the six main categories.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了十九个前沿模型，并分析了每个得分候选框架的来源。 得分较高的候选框架倾向于将跨领域功能集中在更少的模块中。 一个模型的排名在六个主要类别中的变动幅度也可能高达十六位。

paragraphs.en: Doc2Harness has two stages, shown in Figure 2 .
paragraphs.zh: Doc2Harness 包含两个阶段，如图 2 所示。

paragraphs.en: Stage 1, Construction. The builder combines the build model under evaluation with a fixed builder harness . It reads a development document and, starting from a contract skeleton , constructs a candidate harness . The development document prescribes the form and functionality the candidate harness should possess; the contract skeleton is a framework, simplified and adapted from mini-swe-agent ( Yang et al., 2024 ) , that retains only the interfaces and contains no implementation. The builder determines when Stage 1 ends by issuing a submission , without which the build does not count as delivered. At each submission, the contract check verifies that the deliverable compiles and installs, that all required commands are present, that no placeholder stubs remain, and that the three contract interfaces are in place, without running any test case. If the check passes, the build ends and the deliverable is frozen as the candidate harness, never to be modified again; if it fails, the deliverable is returned, and the builder may keep revising and submit again within its quota (§ 3 ). Each scored candidate harness represents the state the model submitted as finished, rather than a state reached only when the time limit expired.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段 1：构建。 构建者将正在评估的构建模型与一个固定的构建器框架相结合。 它读取一份开发文档，并从合同骨架开始，构建一个候选框架。 开发文档规定了候选框架应具备的形式和功能；合同骨架是一个简化并改编自 mini-swe-agent（Yang et al., 2024）的框架，仅保留接口，不包含任何实现。 构建者通过提交成果来判定阶段 1 何时结束，若未提交，则此次构建不计为已交付。 在每次提交时，合同检查会验证交付物能否编译和安装、是否包含所有必要命令、是否没有占位符占位符残留，以及三个合同接口是否已就位，而无需运行任何测试用例。 如果检查通过，构建过程结束，交付物将被锁定为候选框架，此后绝不再修改；如果失败，交付物将被退回，构建者可在其配额（§ 3）范围内继续修订并再次提交。 每个获得分数的候选框架都代表模型提交的最终状态，而非仅在时间限制到期时达到的状态。

paragraphs.en: Stage 2, Evaluation. Inside containers isolated from the construction environment, one per test case, a mock model drives the candidate harness, and we determine the status of each test case in turn. Some test cases are additionally equipped with positive controls , which test whether an apparent pass reflects the required behavior rather than a failure of the observation mechanism (§ 2.4 ). A test case is recorded as PASS only when it passes on its own and every positive control gating it also passes. The build model’s ability to develop a harness is reflected indirectly through the pass rate over test cases. We therefore rank build models rather than candidate harnesses.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段 2：评估。 在与构建环境隔离的容器中（每个测试用例一个容器），一个模拟模型会驱动候选智能体框架，我们依次确定每个测试用例的状态。 部分测试用例还配备了阳性对照，用于检验明显的“通过”是否反映了所需行为，而非观察机制的故障（§ 2.4）。 只有当某个测试用例本身通过，且所有控制其通过的阳性对照也均通过时，该测试用例才会被记录为“通过”。 构建模型开发智能体框架的能力，可通过其在各测试用例上的通过率间接体现。 因此，我们对构建模型进行排名，而非候选智能体框架。

paragraphs.en: Each stage holds one component fixed to reduce confounding. In Stage 1, the builder harness is uniformly the open-source coding agent framework OpenCode ( OpenCode Contributors, 2025 ) rather than harnesses such as Claude Code ( Anthropic, 2025 ) or Codex CLI ( OpenAI, 2025 ) , because such harnesses are developed by model vendors alongside their own models and may confer an advantage on the Claude and GPT model families. In Stage 2, the mock model supplies responses according to a preset script, which avoids interference from the instability that a real LLM introduces.
paragraphs.zh: 每个阶段都固定一个组件，以减少干扰因素。 在阶段 1 中，构建工具统一采用开源编码智能体框架 OpenCode（OpenCode Contributors，2025），而非 Claude Code（Anthropic，2025）或 Codex CLI（OpenAI，2025）等工具，因为这些工具由模型供应商与其自有模型一同开发，可能会为 Claude 和 GPT 模型系列带来优势。 在阶段 2 中，模拟模型根据预设脚本提供响应，从而避免了真实 LLM 所引入的不稳定性带来的干扰。

paragraphs.en: The development document is written in three steps, namely collecting a feature inventory, turning that inventory into clauses, and disambiguating so that the clauses are self-consistent. paragraphs.en: Collecting a feature inventory. In the first phase we crawl the user documentation of twelve frontier harnesses (Claude Code ( Anthropic, 2025 ) , Kimi Code ( Moonshot AI, 2026 ) , Gemini CLI ( Google, 2025 ) , Qwen Code ( Qwen Team, 2025 ) , OpenCode ( OpenCode Contributors, 2025 ) , OpenClaw ( OpenClaw Foundation, 2025 ) , Codex CLI ( OpenAI, 2025 ) , Aider ( Gauthier, 2023 ) , OpenHands ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , Cline ( Cline Bot Inc., 2024 ) , Crush ( Charm, 2025 ) , and Cursor ( Anysphere, 2023 ) ) and extract candidate features from it. The second phase examines each candidate feature from the first phase in greater detail, filling in invocation form, parameter semantics, and boundary behavior. The outputs of the two phases are merged, deduplicated, and pruned into one inventory of frontier-harness capabilities.

paragraphs.en: Turning the inventory into clauses. As shown in Table 1 , the development document covers the deliverable and runtime interface, built-in tools, top-level commands and subcommands, permission and role modes, global flags, in-session commands and shortcuts, persistent memory, convention files, consistency rules, exit codes, and the API for driving automated evaluation. Each clause is given a syntax, a meaning, and an expected behavior. Confining each clause in this way serves two purposes, (1) verifiability from external behavior and (2) independence from implementation. To make the first purpose operational, we require the effect of every feature to be observable through one of four channels, namely the requests sent to the model, the files on disk, the process exit code, and the command output. To serve the second purpose, apart from the three contracts of the contract skeleton we do not constrain the manner of implementation.
paragraphs.zh: 将库存转化为条款。 如表 1 所示，开发文档涵盖了交付成果和运行时接口、内置工具、顶层命令和子命令、权限与角色模式、全局标志、会话内命令和快捷键、持久化内存、约定文件、一致性规则、退出代码以及用于驱动自动化评估的 API。 每个条款都被赋予了句法、含义和预期行为。 以这种方式限定每个条款有两个目的：（1）通过外部行为实现可验证性，以及（2）实现与具体实现方式的独立性。 为实现第一个目的，我们要求每个功能的效果必须通过四种渠道之一进行观察，即发送给模型请求、磁盘上的文件、进程退出代码和命令输出。 为实现第二个目的，除了契约骨架中的三项契约外，我们不限制具体的实现方式。

paragraphs.en: Disambiguating features. The clauses from the previous step come from twelve sources, and to avoid semantic conflicts we use the following two disambiguation rules. (1) We merge commands with overlapping semantics. For example, Claude Code names context compaction /compact whereas Cursor names it /summarize , and the development document adopts /compact . (2) We split distinct concepts that occupy the same name. Take the word plan : in Claude Code it is one of six permission modes and means read-only, whereas in Aider, proposing changes and carrying out edits are handled by two model roles, architect and editor, and Aider’s documentation instead specifies the responsibilities assigned to each role. The development document accordingly assigns the read-only constraint to permissions and responsibility for proposing and applying changes to roles, so that permissions and roles each form their own clause.
paragraphs.zh: 消除歧义的特征。 上一步骤中的子句来自十二个来源，为避免语义冲突，我们使用以下两条消歧规则。 (1) 我们将语义重叠的命令进行合并。 例如，Claude Code 将上下文压缩命名为 /compact，而 Cursor 则命名为 /summarize，开发文档中采用的则是 /compact。 (2) 我们将占用相同名称的不同概念进行拆分。 以“plan”一词为例：在 Claude Code 中，它是六种权限模式之一，意为只读；而在 Aider 中，提出更改和执行编辑由两个模型角色——架构师和编辑——分别处理，Aider 的文档则具体说明了分配给每个角色的职责。 因此，开发文档将只读约束分配给权限，而提出和应用的更改的责任则分配给角色，这样权限和角色各自形成独立的子句。

paragraphs.en: Composition. The contract skeleton consists of five Python source files (roughly seventy lines in total), plus one install script, one entry script, and one project config. Three of its interfaces constitute an immutable external contract, namely (1) the CLI, (2) the headless entry point, and (3) the API for driving automated evaluation. A representative candidate harness runs to approximately 30 Python source files and approximately 16,000 lines, of which roughly 99.6% is written by the build model beyond what the contract skeleton supplies.

paragraphs.en: Construction environment. Every build takes place in a newly created empty container, into which the contract skeleton and the development document are copied and which has no external network access other than the designated model gateway. Before construction begins we run a preflight check confirming that the container holds no unexpected files and that OpenCode starts normally; failure of either condition aborts the build and produces no result.
paragraphs.zh: 构建环境。 每次构建都在一个新创建的空白容器中执行，该容器会复制合同框架和开发文档，且除指定的模型网关外，无法访问任何外部网络。 在构建开始前，我们会运行一次预检，确认容器内没有意外文件且 OpenCode 能够正常启动；若任一条件不满足，构建将中止且不会生成任何结果。

paragraphs.en: At design time, a test case must satisfy two requirements at once: it must be anchored to some clause of the development document, and it must discriminate between implementations; whether a retained case actually discriminates is settled only after evaluation. As shown in Figure 3 , we use three methods in a yield-driven cycle, the first two broadening the coverage of the test cases and the third deepening what they inspect. § 2.3.1 draws on the public records of harness users, § 2.3.2 on the source of mature harnesses, and § 2.3.3 on the existing test suite itself. We move to the next method when the current method’s marginal yield declines. Because the methods draw on different sources, they also use different filtering criteria.
paragraphs.zh: 在设计阶段，一个测试用例必须同时满足两个要求：它必须锚定开发文档中的某条条款，并且必须能够区分不同的实现；而一个保留的测试用例是否确实具备这种区分能力，只有在评估之后才能确定。 如图 3 所示，我们在一个以产出为导向的循环中使用了三种方法：前两种方法用于扩大测试用例的覆盖范围，第三种方法则用于加深其检查的深度。§ 2.3.1 参考了测试框架用户的公开记录，§ 2.3.2 参考了成熟测试框架的来源，而 § 2.3.3 则参考了现有的测试套件本身。 当当前方法的边际产出下降时，我们会转向使用下一个方法。 由于这些方法依赖不同的来源，因此它们也使用了不同的筛选标准。

paragraphs.en: This method rests on an assumption about the distribution of defects. LLMs are trained on code written by human developers. Mature harnesses and the harnesses written by build models face the same interface semantics and the same class of boundary conditions. We therefore expect substantial overlap between the defects mature harnesses have exposed over years of evolution and the mistakes made by the harnesses written by build models, which makes public issue records a ready source of candidates.
paragraphs.zh: 这种方法基于对缺陷分布的一个假设。 LLM 是在人类开发者编写的代码上进行训练的。 成熟的测试框架和由构建模型编写的测试框架面临相同的接口语义和相同类型的边界条件。 因此，我们预计，成熟的测试框架在多年演化过程中暴露出的缺陷，与构建模型编写的测试框架所犯的错误之间会有大量重叠，这使得公开的缺陷记录成为候选问题的便捷来源。

sents.en: This method rests on an assumption about the distribution of defects.
sents.zh: 这种方法基于对缺陷分布的一个假设。

sents.en: LLMs are trained on code written by human developers.
sents.zh: LLM 是在人类开发者编写的代码上进行训练的。

sents.en: Mature harnesses and the harnesses written by build models face the same interface semantics and the same class of boundary conditions.
sents.zh: 成熟的测试框架和由构建模型编写的测试框架面临相同的接口语义和相同类型的边界条件。

sents.en: We therefore expect substantial overlap between the defects mature harnesses have exposed over years of evolution and the mistakes made by the harnesses written by build models, which makes public issue records a ready source of candidates.
sents.zh: 因此，我们预计，成熟的测试框架在多年演化过程中暴露出的缺陷，与构建模型编写的测试框架所犯的错误之间会有大量重叠，这使得公开的缺陷记录成为候选问题的便捷来源。

paragraphs.en: Collection. We pull every issue from the public repositories of four frontier harnesses (Claude Code, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, and Kimi Code); after filtering out pull requests these number 9,868, 5,438, 4,831, and 946 respectively, 21,083 in total.
paragraphs.zh: 收集。 我们从四个前沿工具（Claude Code、OpenCode、Gemini CLI 和 Kimi Code）的公开仓库中拉取所有问题；在过滤掉拉取请求后，这些问题的数量分别为 9,868、5,438、4,831 和 946，总计 21,083。

sents.en: Collection.
sents.zh: 收集。

sents.en: We pull every issue from the public repositories of four frontier harnesses (Claude Code, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, and Kimi Code); after filtering out pull requests these number 9,868, 5,438, 4,831, and 946 respectively, 21,083 in total.
sents.zh: 我们从四个前沿工具（Claude Code、OpenCode、Gemini CLI 和 Kimi Code）的公开仓库中拉取所有问题；在过滤掉拉取请求后，这些问题的数量分别为 9,868、5,438、4,831 和 946，总计 21,083。

paragraphs.en: Ranking and stopping. More than 20,000 records cannot be reviewed manually in full, so we first rank them by relevance to the development document. Manual review starts at the top of the ranking and stops when the marginal yield falls below the cost of further review.
paragraphs.zh: 排序与停止。 超过 20,000 条记录无法全部人工审核，因此我们首先根据它们与开发文档的相关性进行排序。 人工审核从排序结果的最顶端开始，当边际收益低于继续审核的成本时即停止。

sents.en: Ranking and stopping.
sents.zh: 排序与停止。

sents.en: More than 20,000 records cannot be reviewed manually in full, so we first rank them by relevance to the development document.
sents.zh: 超过 20,000 条记录无法全部人工审核，因此我们首先根据它们与开发文档的相关性进行排序。

sents.en: Manual review starts at the top of the ranking and stops when the marginal yield falls below the cost of further review.
sents.zh: 人工审核从排序结果的最顶端开始，当边际收益低于继续审核的成本时即停止。

paragraphs.en: Clustering. The same defect is often reported repeatedly, worded differently yet all pointing at one feature. We cluster the records we have read by the phenomenon they report, forming one candidate test case per cluster, into whose material the records of that cluster are then merged.
paragraphs.zh: 聚类。 同样的缺陷常常被反复报告，尽管措辞不同，但都指向同一个功能。 我们根据记录中报告的现象对已读取的记录进行聚类，每个聚类形成一个候选测试用例，然后将该聚类的记录合并到其内容中。

sents.en: Clustering.
sents.zh: 聚类。

sents.en: The same defect is often reported repeatedly, worded differently yet all pointing at one feature.
sents.zh: 同样的缺陷常常被反复报告，尽管措辞不同，但都指向同一个功能。

sents.en: We cluster the records we have read by the phenomenon they report, forming one candidate test case per cluster, into whose material the records of that cluster are then merged.
sents.zh: 我们根据记录中报告的现象对已读取的记录进行聚类，每个聚类形成一个候选测试用例，然后将该聚类的记录合并到其内容中。

paragraphs.en: Filtering. Distinct phenomena may still land on the same point of the implementation. Where two clusters anchor to the same clause and the effects they observe are too close, the test cases realized from them would pass and fail together on the same set of implementations, so only the one with more complete material is kept. A remaining candidate is retained only if it can additionally be turned into a deterministic assertion and is not yet covered by the existing test suite.
paragraphs.zh: 过滤。 不同的现象仍可能最终指向相同的实现点。 当两个簇锚定到同一子句，且它们观察到的效果过于接近时，由此产生的测试用例在相同的实现集上会同时通过或失败，因此只保留材料更完整的那个。 仅当某个剩余候选项能够进一步转化为确定性断言，并且尚未被现有测试套件覆盖时，才会被保留。

sents.en: Filtering.
sents.zh: 过滤。

sents.en: Distinct phenomena may still land on the same point of the implementation.
sents.zh: 不同的现象仍可能最终指向相同的实现点。

sents.en: Where two clusters anchor to the same clause and the effects they observe are too close, the test cases realized from them would pass and fail together on the same set of implementations, so only the one with more complete material is kept.
sents.zh: 当两个簇锚定到同一子句，且它们观察到的效果过于接近时，由此产生的测试用例在相同的实现集上会同时通过或失败，因此只保留材料更完整的那个。

sents.en: A remaining candidate is retained only if it can additionally be turned into a deterministic assertion and is not yet covered by the existing test suite.
sents.zh: 仅当某个剩余候选项能够进一步转化为确定性断言，并且尚未被现有测试套件覆盖时，才会被保留。

paragraphs.en: This method’s net yield is high at the outset and falls as the same sources are mined further, on which basis we turn to the next method.
paragraphs.zh: 这种方法在初始阶段的净收益很高，但随着对同一资源来源的进一步开采，收益会逐渐下降，因此我们转而采用下一种方法。

paragraphs.en: The previous method is limited by the quantity and quality of external records; this method broadens coverage from the source side instead. We compare one candidate harness against the public source of a mature harness and examine which capabilities that candidate harness lacks. We call the mature implementation that serves as the reference the comparison target; examples include Kimi Code and Qwen Code.
paragraphs.zh: 先前的方法受限于外部记录的数量和质量；而这种方法则从源端扩展覆盖范围。 我们将一个候选框架与成熟框架的公开源进行比较，并检查该候选框架缺少哪些功能。 我们将作为参考的成熟实现称为比较目标；例如 Kimi Code 和 Qwen Code。

sents.en: The previous method is limited by the quantity and quality of external records; this method broadens coverage from the source side instead.
sents.zh: 先前的方法受限于外部记录的数量和质量；而这种方法则从源端扩展覆盖范围。

sents.en: We compare one candidate harness against the public source of a mature harness and examine which capabilities that candidate harness lacks.
sents.zh: 我们将一个候选框架与成熟框架的公开源进行比较，并检查该候选框架缺少哪些功能。

sents.en: We call the mature implementation that serves as the reference the comparison target; examples include Kimi Code and Qwen Code.
sents.zh: 我们将作为参考的成熟实现称为比较目标；例如 Kimi Code 和 Qwen Code。

paragraphs.en: Partition. A candidate harness’s source is partitioned into modules according to the features the development document lists, each module corresponding to one group of features in the document.
paragraphs.zh: 划分。 候选框架的源代码会根据开发文档中列出的功能被划分为多个模块，每个模块对应文档中的一个功能组。

sents.en: Partition.
sents.zh: 划分。

sents.en: A candidate harness’s source is partitioned into modules according to the features the development document lists, each module corresponding to one group of features in the document.
sents.zh: 候选框架的源代码会根据开发文档中列出的功能被划分为多个模块，每个模块对应文档中的一个功能组。

paragraphs.en: Comparison. The same partition is applied to the source of the comparison target, which places the two on a common set of functional boundaries, and we enumerate their implementation differences module by module, covering both the features the comparison target handles and the candidate harness does not, and the boundaries on which the two behave differently.
paragraphs.zh: 比较。 将相同的分区应用于比较目标的源端，从而将两者置于共同的函数边界集合之上；然后我们按模块枚举其实现差异，涵盖比较目标所处理而候选辅助工具未处理的特征，以及两者行为存在差异的边界。

sents.en: Comparison.
sents.zh: 比较。

sents.en: The same partition is applied to the source of the comparison target, which places the two on a common set of functional boundaries, and we enumerate their implementation differences module by module, covering both the features the comparison target handles and the candidate harness does not, and the boundaries on which the two behave differently.
sents.zh: 将相同的分区应用于比较目标的源端，从而将两者置于共同的函数边界集合之上；然后我们按模块枚举其实现差异，涵盖比较目标所处理而候选辅助工具未处理的特征，以及两者行为存在差异的边界。

paragraphs.en: Attribution. A difference does not necessarily stem from a defect; it may merely reflect a different manner of implementation. Every difference is traced back to the development document, and only those derivable from the purpose of some clause count as candidate test cases.
paragraphs.zh: 归属。 差异并不一定源于缺陷；它可能仅仅反映了不同的实现方式。 所有差异都可追溯至开发文档，且只有那些可从某条款目的中推导出的差异才被视为候选测试用例。

sents.en: Attribution.
sents.zh: 归属。

sents.en: A difference does not necessarily stem from a defect; it may merely reflect a different manner of implementation.
sents.zh: 差异并不一定源于缺陷；它可能仅仅反映了不同的实现方式。

sents.en: Every difference is traced back to the development document, and only those derivable from the purpose of some clause count as candidate test cases.
sents.zh: 所有差异都可追溯至开发文档，且只有那些可从某条款目的中推导出的差异才被视为候选测试用例。

paragraphs.en: The coverage of this method is capped by the functional surface of the comparison target: once the candidate test cases obtainable from comparison are exhausted, we turn to the next method.
paragraphs.zh: 该方法的有效范围受限于比较目标的功能表面：一旦通过比较所能获取的候选测试用例被穷尽，我们将转而采用下一种方法。

paragraphs.en: This method starts from a test case already known to discriminate and changes exactly one thing each time, so as to deepen what the test cases inspect.
paragraphs.zh: 该方法从一个已知具有区分能力的测试用例开始，每次仅更改一个要素，从而加深测试用例的检验范围。

paragraphs.en: Seed selection. We take a test case already shown to discriminate as the seed test case; the defect it exposes is the target of that expansion round.
paragraphs.zh: 种子选择。 我们采用一个已被证明具有区分能力的测试用例作为种子测试用例；它暴露出的缺陷即该扩展轮的目标。

sents.en: Seed selection.
sents.zh: 种子选择。

sents.en: We take a test case already shown to discriminate as the seed test case; the defect it exposes is the target of that expansion round.
sents.zh: 我们采用一个已被证明具有区分能力的测试用例作为种子测试用例；它暴露出的缺陷即该扩展轮的目标。

paragraphs.en: Expansion. A test case consists of a scenario and an assertion; the scenario is the session through which the mock model drives the candidate harness, and it fixes only the setting and the flow, while the adjudication rests with the assertion. We vary only the scenario, keeping the assertion fixed. Each time we change exactly one variable of the seed scenario to obtain a new candidate, and every candidate must still be anchored to some clause of the development document. We use four variables.
paragraphs.zh: 扩展。 一个测试用例由一个场景和一个断言组成；场景是模拟模型通过其驱动候选框架的会话，它仅固定设置和流程，而裁决则取决于断言。 我们仅改变场景，保持断言不变。 每次我们恰好改变种子场景的一个变量以获得一个新的候选者，并且每个候选者都必须仍然锚定到开发文档中的某个条款。我们使用四个变量。

sents.en: Expansion.
sents.zh: 扩展。

sents.en: A test case consists of a scenario and an assertion; the scenario is the session through which the mock model drives the candidate harness, and it fixes only the setting and the flow, while the adjudication rests with the assertion.
sents.zh: 一个测试用例由一个场景和一个断言组成；场景是模拟模型通过其驱动候选框架的会话，它仅固定设置和流程，而裁决则取决于断言。

sents.en: We vary only the scenario, keeping the assertion fixed.
sents.zh: 我们仅改变场景，保持断言不变。

sents.en: Each time we change exactly one variable of the seed scenario to obtain a new candidate, and every candidate must still be anchored to some clause of the development document. We use four variables.
sents.zh: 每次我们恰好改变种子场景的一个变量以获得一个新的候选者，并且每个候选者都必须仍然锚定到开发文档中的某个条款。我们使用四个变量。

paragraphs.en: The tool. A coding agent can often reach the same end through several tools, while a candidate harness may implement only some of them correctly.
paragraphs.zh: 该工具。 编码智能体通常可以通过多种工具达到相同的结果，而候选工具集可能只能正确实现其中的一部分。

sents.en: The tool.
sents.zh: 该工具。

sents.en: A coding agent can often reach the same end through several tools, while a candidate harness may implement only some of them correctly.
sents.zh: 编码智能体通常可以通过多种工具达到相同的结果，而候选工具集可能只能正确实现其中的一部分。

paragraphs.en: The input form. The same inspection can be triggered by inputs of several forms; when inspecting path escape, we can replace the input with a symlink to a file, a symlink to a directory, a multi-level symlink, or a relative-path symlink.
paragraphs.zh: 输入形式。 相同的检查可以通过多种形式的输入触发；在检查路径逃逸时，我们可以将输入替换为指向某个文件的符号链接、指向某个目录的符号链接、多级符号链接或相对路径符号链接。

sents.en: The input form.
sents.zh: 输入形式。

paragraphs.en: A test case that passes does not necessarily show that the candidate harness has implemented the requirement in question. Consider path escape: the mock model’s script has the candidate harness read a symlink pointing outside the workspace with its read tool, and the test case asserts that the external file’s content does not appear in the requests sent to the model. That the content is absent may mean the implementation blocked this out-of-bounds read, or it may mean its read tool cannot read any file at all. The assertion holds in both situations; only the former constitutes meeting the requirement, and the latter is a vacuous pass.
paragraphs.zh: 一个通过测试的测试用例并不必然表明候选智能体已实现所讨论的需求。 考虑路径逃逸问题：模拟模型的脚本会引导候选智能体使用其读取工具读取一个指向工作区外部符号链接的文件，而测试用例则断言模型收到的请求中不会出现该外部文件的内容。 内容缺失可能意味着实现阻止了这种越界读取操作，也可能意味着其读取工具根本无法读取任何文件。 无论哪种情况，该断言都成立；只有前者才表示满足需求，而后者则是一种空洞的通过。

paragraphs.en: To rule out vacuous passes, we design the positive control mechanism. A positive control shares the scenario and the fixture with its test case, where the fixture consists of the files and initial state prepared in the workspace before a run. It changes only the input or access route, selects a case outside the constraint imposed by the clause under test, and asserts an outcome that must occur when the observation precondition holds, that is, when the effect the test case inspects is in fact observable. In the example above, the positive control reuses the same symlink, accesses it through the bash tool instead, and asserts that the external file is indeed readable.
paragraphs.zh: 为了排除无效操作，我们设计了正向控制机制。 正向控制与测试用例共享相同的场景和固定组件，其中固定组件包括运行前在工作区中准备好的文件和初始状态。 它仅更改输入或访问路径，选择一个不受被测试条款所施加限制的影响的案例，并断言当观察前提条件成立时（即当测试用例所检查的效果实际上可被观察到时）必须出现的结果。 在上面的例子中，正向控制重用了相同的符号链接，但通过 bash 工具进行访问，并断言外部文件确实可读。

sents.en: To rule out vacuous passes, we design the positive control mechanism.
sents.zh: 为了排除无效操作，我们设计了正向控制机制。

sents.en: A positive control shares the scenario and the fixture with its test case, where the fixture consists of the files and initial state prepared in the workspace before a run.

sents.en: In the example above, the positive control reuses the same symlink, accesses it through the bash tool instead, and asserts that the external file is indeed readable.

paragraphs.en: We group test cases that share an observation precondition under one positive control, and a test case with several such preconditions is gated by several controls. If a positive control fails, the precondition does not hold, so a pass by the test cases in its group can only be vacuous and they are recorded as FAIL regardless of their own statuses. Positive controls themselves do not count toward the pass rate.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将共享同一观察先决条件的测试用例归入一个正向控制项，而包含多个此类先决条件的测试用例则由多个控制项进行门控。 如果某个正向控制项失败，则对应的先决条件不成立，因此该组中的测试用例即使通过，其结果也仅属空值，无论其自身状态如何，均会被记录为 FAIL。 正向控制项本身不计入通过率。

sents.en: We group test cases that share an observation precondition under one positive control, and a test case with several such preconditions is gated by several controls.
sents.zh: 我们将共享同一观察先决条件的测试用例归入一个正向控制项，而包含多个此类先决条件的测试用例则由多个控制项进行门控。

sents.en: If a positive control fails, the precondition does not hold, so a pass by the test cases in its group can only be vacuous and they are recorded as FAIL regardless of their own statuses.
sents.zh: 如果某个正向控制项失败，则对应的先决条件不成立，因此该组中的测试用例即使通过，其结果也仅属空值，无论其自身状态如何，均会被记录为 FAIL。

sents.en: Positive controls themselves do not count toward the pass rate.
sents.zh: 正向控制项本身不计入通过率。

paragraphs.en: Given that the assertion is correctly constructed, a vacuous pass has three causes, each ruled out by one class of positive control.
paragraphs.zh: 鉴于该论断已正确构建，空泛通过存在三个原因，而每一类原因都可通过某一类的阳性对照予以排除。

paragraphs.en: Channel. The tool’s result may never reach the channel being observed at all. A test case observes only one of the four channels; if an implementation’s read tool never places file content into a request, then the content of a file outside the workspace will not appear there either. We therefore read an ordinary file with the read tool and confirm that its content does appear in the requests sent to the model. Failure here means the implementation does not put tool results onto this channel at all, so the absence of the forbidden content does not constitute interception. The path-escape test case does not require a control of its own, because its reverse control, described below, already covers this condition.
paragraphs.zh: 通道。 该工具的结果可能根本不会到达正在被观察的通道。 一个测试用例仅观察四个通道中的一个；如果实现中的读取工具从未将文件内容放入请求中，那么工作区之外的文件内容也不会出现在那里。 因此，我们使用读取工具读取一个普通文件，并确认其内容确实出现在发送给模型的需求中。 此处的失败意味着该实现完全没有将工具结果放到这个通道上，因此禁止内容的缺失并不构成拦截。 路径逃逸测试用例不需要独立的控制，因为其反向控制（如下所述）已经涵盖了这种情况。

sents.zh: 因此，我们使用读取工具读取一个普通文件，并确认其内容确实出现在发送给模型的需求中。

paragraphs.en: Same form. This rules out failures that would have occurred even without the constraint under test. Reusing the same input form and changing only the route of access, we access the same symlink through the implementation’s bash tool and confirm that it resolves outside the workspace and that the file there is readable (the path-escape clause constrains file tools, and commands executed by bash fall outside its scope). Failure here means the implementation cannot complete even an access unconstrained by the clause, so its miss on the access under test has nothing to do with interception.
paragraphs.zh: 形式相同。 这排除了即使在没有受测约束的情况下也会发生的故障。 通过重复使用相同的输入形式，并且仅更改访问路径，我们通过实现中的 bash 工具访问同一个符号链接，并确认该链接解析到工作区之外，且其中的文件可读（路径逃逸条款对文件工具施加了限制，而 bash 执行的命令则不在其作用范围内）。 此处的故障意味着该实现甚至无法完成不受该条款限制的访问，因此它在受测访问中的失败与拦截无关。

paragraphs.en: Reverse. This rules out the case where the implementation refuses inputs of this kind categorically, on grounds other than this access being out of bounds. An implementation that refuses all symlinks passes the test case above, yet it also refuses symlinks pointing inside the workspace, which are valid in normal use. We therefore replace the input with such a symlink, perform the same read, and confirm that its content still appears in the requests sent to the model. Failure here means the pass did not arise from recognizing an out-of-bounds read.
paragraphs.zh: 反过来。 这排除了这样一种情况：实现基于除访问超出范围之外的其他原因，完全拒绝此类输入。 一个拒绝所有符号链接的实现可以通过上述测试用例，但它也拒绝了指向工作区内部的符号链接，而这些链接在正常使用中是有效的。 因此，我们将输入替换为这样一个符号链接，执行相同的读取操作，并确认其内容仍然出现在发送给模型的需求中。 如果在此处失败，则意味着通过测试并非因为识别出了一次超出范围的读取。

paragraphs.en: Coverage of the positive controls. Of the 328 test cases, 130 are gated by at least one positive control (Figure 4 b), of which 114 are gated by one, 15 by two, and one by three. The control with the widest scope gates six test cases and confirms that a symlink pointing outside the workspace is in fact readable; the next two gate five each and confirm, respectively, that reading by range works and that a search returns a hit. These three thus check the observation preconditions shared by the most test cases.

paragraphs.en: Configuration. In Stage 1, the builder harness is OpenCode 1.17.0, installed into the build container as a single compiled executable. The builder constructs the candidate harness through OpenCode’s non-interactive entry point opencode run , with the task description supplied once on the command line. Because that entry point advances the session by only one turn per invocation, we resume the same session with --continue , as OpenCode’s official documentation describes, and supply a further prompt whenever no submission has yet been made, up to twenty-four turns or until the wall clock is exhausted. As the session approaches the context limit, the builder harness compacts the history automatically, with the trigger threshold set at eighty percent of the model’s context window. Each build is subject to a two-hour wall-clock limit and to a quota of at most three submissions, and terminates as soon as either is exhausted. In Stage 2, every test case is executed once inside its own container, on its own fixture, subject to a 900-second limit beyond which execution is terminated and the test case recorded as FAIL.
paragraphs.zh: 配置。 在第一阶段，构建器框架为 OpenCode 1.17.0，作为单个编译好的可执行文件安装到构建容器中。 构建器通过 OpenCode 的非交互式入口点 opencode run 来构建候选框架，任务描述仅需在命令行中提供一次。 由于该入口点每次调用仅推进会话一个回合，因此我们使用 --continue 恢复同一会话（如 OpenCode 官方文档所述），并在尚未提交任何结果时继续提供提示，直至达到二十四回合或墙钟时间耗尽为止。 当会话接近上下文限制时，构建器框架会自动压缩历史记录，触发阈值设为模型上下文窗口的百分之八十。 每次构建均受两小时墙钟时间限制和最多三次提交配额的限制，任一条件耗尽即终止构建。 在第二阶段，每个测试用例都在其自身的容器中执行一次，使用其专属的 fixture，执行时间上限为 900 秒；超过该时限则终止执行，并将该测试用例记录为失败。

As shown in Table 2 , GPT-6 Astra attains the highest pass rate at 53.05%, while the weakest model, Hy3, reaches 27.44%, a gap of roughly twenty-six percentage points. paragraphs.zh: 该测试套件远未达到饱和状态。 如表 2 所示，GPT-6 Astra 的通过率最高，为 53.05%，而表现最差的模型 Hy3 的通过率为 27.44%，两者相差约 26 个百分点。 即便是最强的模型，也有近一半的测试用例未能通过。 因此，该测试套件既未在这一模型群体中达到饱和状态，也并非无法区分各模型之间的差异。

paragraphs.en: The categories differ sharply in discriminative power. As shown in Table 3 , the permissions category provides the greatest separation among models: its average pass rate is 43.7%, its strong-weak gap is 50.8 points, and 51 of its 61 test cases are discriminating. File operations has a comparable average pass rate of 39.6% but a gap of only 20.9 points. The interactive-terminal category averages 79.9% and is approaching saturation. In addition, 56 test cases are failed by every candidate harness, so these cases provide no discrimination within the evaluated cohort; they are concentrated in the direct drive, session state, permissions, and headless categories.
paragraphs.zh: 这些类别在区分能力上存在显著差异。 如表3所示，权限类别在各模型间的区分度最高：其平均通过率为43.7%，强弱模型之间的差距为50.8分，且61个测试用例中有51个具有区分性。 文件操作的平均通过率也相当，为39.6%，但差距仅为20.9分。 交互式终端类别的平均通过率为79.9%，已接近饱和状态。 此外，有56个测试用例在所有候选框架中均失败，因此这些用例在受评估的模型群体中无法提供区分性；它们主要集中在直接驱动、会话状态、权限和无头模式等类别中。

paragraphs.en: A model’s rank varies greatly across categories. Among the six main categories, each of which holds at least twenty test cases, a model’s rank varies by as many as sixteen positions: Grok 4.7 ranks first on file operations but eleventh on session state, Opus 4.6 third on direct drive but nineteenth on permissions, and Hy4 preview fifth on session state but nineteenth on direct drive. GPT-6 Astra leads four of the six categories, while Grok 4.7 and Qwen3.8 Max lead the remaining two. The categories show positive pairwise associations rather than clear trade-offs. All fifteen pairwise correlations between the six main categories are positive, with a mean of + 0.521 +0.521 , and the overall pass rate correlates with all six of them, five between 0.69 and 0.94. These results are consistent with a largely one-dimensional capability: models differ mainly in overall capability rather than in which categories they specialize in. Model rankings nevertheless vary substantially across categories.
paragraphs.zh: 模型在不同类别中的排名差异很大。 在六个主要类别中，每个类别至少包含二十个测试用例，模型在这些类别中的排名差异可达十六位：Grok 4.7 在文件操作方面排名第一，但在会话状态方面仅排第十一；Opus 4.6 在直接驱动方面排名第三，但在权限方面却排第十九；Hy4 preview 在会话状态方面排名第五，但在直接驱动方面同样排第十九。 GPT-6 Astra 在六个类别中领先四个，而 Grok 4.7 和 Qwen3.8 Max 则分别领先其余两个类别。 这些类别表现出正向的成对相关性，而非明显的权衡关系。 六个主要类别之间的十五个成对相关系数均为正值，平均值为 +0.521，整体通过率与这六个类别均存在相关性，其中五个相关系数介于 0.69 至 0.94 之间。 这些结果与一种基本上一维的能力模型一致：模型之间的差异主要体现在整体能力上，而非它们所擅长的具体类别。 尽管如此，模型在不同类别中的排名仍存在显著差异。

paragraphs.en: The test suite is a reliable instrument. The KR-20 coefficient computed over the fifty-seven candidate harnesses across all test cases is 0.913, indicating high internal consistency, as expected if the test cases measure one underlying capability.

paragraphs.en: Implementation scale is set mainly by the model. As shown in Table 4 , per-model mean code size ranges from 1,271 to 16,681 lines, and across the fifty-seven builds the range is 1,062 to 19,208. Most of this variation lies between models rather than among the three builds of a given model: 95.9% of the variance in code lines is between models, and the coefficient of variation across the three builds of a model averages 12.7%, compared with 60.1% across the nineteen model means. The corresponding between-model variance shares are 87.9% for module count, 80.6% for lines per module, and 95.7% for largest-module share; Figure 5 shows the same between-model dominance for code lines. The correlation between code lines and pass rate is 0.614 across the fifty-seven builds, and 0.629 between the model means. Implementation scale is driven mainly by model identity, with comparatively little variation across a model’s three builds.
paragraphs.zh: 实现规模主要由模型决定。 如表4所示，每个模型的平均代码行数在1,271到16,681行之间，而57个构建版本中的范围则为1,062到19,208行。 这种差异主要存在于不同模型之间，而非同一模型的三个构建版本之间：代码行数的95.9%的方差来自不同模型之间的差异，而同一模型三个构建版本的变异系数平均为12.7%，远低于19个模型均值之间的60.1%。 相应的模型间方差占比分别为模块数量87.9%、每个模块的行数80.6%以及最大模块占比95.7%；图5显示了代码行数同样存在这种模型间的显著差异。 在57个构建版本中，代码行数与通过率的相关系数为0.614，而在模型均值之间则为0.629。 实现规模主要由模型本身决定，同一模型的三个构建版本之间的差异相对较小。

paragraphs.en: Coding benchmarks have evolved toward tasks involving increasingly large codebases, and fall broadly into two classes: code completion and repository-level generation.
paragraphs.zh: 编码基准测试已逐渐转向涉及日益庞大的代码库的任务，并大致分为两类：代码补全和仓库级生成。

paragraphs.en: Benchmarks in the completion class ask for local edits to existing code. HumanEval ( Chen et al., 2021 ) established the practice of judging a single function by unit tests, and MBPP ( Austin et al., 2021 ) and EvalPlus ( Liu et al., 2023 ) extended this unit-test-based paradigm to a larger scale; the scope then grew to a whole repository with SWE-bench ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) , which asks the model to resolve a real issue and judges by the tests shipped with the corresponding pull request. Variants of SWE-bench extend this setup while addressing contamination ( Deng et al., 2026 ) , evaluating end-to-end performance on freelance tasks ( Miserendino et al., 2025 ) , or deriving specifications from documentation changes ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 完成类基准测试要求对现有代码进行局部编辑。 HumanEval（Chen 等人，2021）确立了通过单元测试来评估单个函数的做法，而 MBPP（Austin 等人，2021）和 EvalPlus（Liu 等人，2023）则将这种基于单元测试的范式扩展到了更大规模；随后 SWE-bench（Jimenez 等人，2024）将范围扩大至整个代码库，它要求模型解决一个实际问题，并通过随相应拉取请求附带的测试进行评判。 SWE-bench 的各种变体在解决污染问题（Deng 等人，2026）、评估自由职业任务中的端到端性能（Miserendino 等人，2025），或从文档变更中推导出规范（Jiang 等人，2026）的同时，也扩展了这一设置。

paragraphs.en: Repository-level generation removes the existing implementation and asks for a complete one. The evaluation criterion depends on the available reference implementation. Commit0 ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) and NL2Repo-Bench ( Ding et al., 2026 ) ask models to reconstruct released libraries and judge by the supplied or upstream unit tests. RepoZero ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) compares output equivalence against a second implementation; ProgramBench ( Yang et al., 2026 ) uses a reference executable to generate end-to-end tests through fuzzing; and DeepSWE ( Huang et al., 2026b ) hand-writes a verifier per task that accepts any implementation of the requested feature set.

paragraphs.en: A harness is a class of software whose functional surface can be enumerated feature by feature ( de Macedo, 2026 ; Guo et al., 2026 ; Barbaste et al., 2026 ) . This makes it a suitable target for a construction benchmark. Most harness benchmarks evaluate existing harnesses. Claw-SWE-Bench ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) fixes the prompt, budget, workspace, and evaluator, and finds that the choice of harness shifts scores by 27.4 points, compared with 29.4 points for the choice of model; Harness-Bench ( Yao et al., 2026 ) isolates configuration-level effects over 106 sandboxed tasks and concludes that ability should be reported at the model–harness configuration level rather than attributed to the base model alone.
paragraphs.zh: 测试框架是一类软件，其功能表面可以按特征逐一枚举（de Macedo, 2026；Guo et al., 2026；Barbaste et al., 2026）。 这使其成为构建基准测试的合适目标。 大多数测试框架基准测试都评估现有的测试框架。 Claw-SWE-Bench（Zheng et al., 2026）固定了提示、预算、工作空间和评估器，并发现测试框架的选择会使分数产生 27.4 分的差异，而模型的选择则会产生 29.4 分的差异；Harness-Bench（Yao et al., 2026）在 106 个沙盒化任务中隔离了配置层面的影响，并得出结论：能力应在模型–测试框架的配置层面进行报告，而非仅归因于基础模型本身。

Still others let the given harness change from stage to stage and ask whether the agent keeps pace ( Ke et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 其他基准测试则保持测试框架固定，并评估其单一能力，例如智能体读取不同表面时的规则遵循性（Huang 等，2026c）、渐进式披露下的技能检索能力（Han 等，2026）、组件生命周期推理能力（Sileo & Kachler，2026），或在策略阶梯和持久化载体中的安全性表现（Davidovich 等，2026；Bai 等，2026；Zhang 等，2026a）。 还有一些测试则允许给定的测试框架在不同阶段发生变化，并考察智能体是否能够同步适应（Ke 等，2026）。

paragraphs.en: A further line of work asks a model to produce or revise the harness itself, starting from an existing harness and its execution feedback ( Wu et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2026a ; Ursekar et al., 2026 ) ; because gains are measured on downstream tasks, they cannot be separated from those obtained by simply allowing more test-time search, a confound noted in this literature ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . All of these studies infer harness quality from downstream tasks. Such tasks must be prepared in advance, and the ability of the model that drives them also influences the measured score. Nor is output-only scoring sufficient, since a harness can return a correct and harmless answer along a trajectory that reached unauthorized resources, and output-level evaluation cannot see failures of that kind ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . None of them adjudicates, clause by clause, whether a harness’s own behavior conforms to a specification.

paragraphs.en: Doc2Harness differs from the work above in three respects. First, the target deliverable does not correspond to any existing implementation: the development document consolidates the functionality of twelve frontier harnesses into a self-consistent set of clauses, whereas prior repository-level deliverables are reconstructions of something already published. Second, the candidate harness is driven by a mock model following a preset script rather than by a real model on downstream tasks, so the evaluation is deterministic and what is judged is the candidate harness itself. Third, the candidate harness is executed end to end as a black box through a complete scripted session, with effects read from four channels. This makes constraints of the form “a rejected operation must not take place” adjudicable clause by clause; and because an assertion requiring some effect not to appear may hold simply because the feature under test never ran, such test cases are equipped with positive controls confirming that the observation precondition holds. In sum, Doc2Harness is the first benchmark able to assess deterministically how well a model develops a harness.
paragraphs.zh: Doc2Harness 在三个方面与上述工作有所不同。 首先，其目标交付成果并不对应任何现有实现：开发文档将十二个前沿 harness 的功能整合为一套自洽的条款，而以往的仓库级交付成果则是对已有发布内容的重构。 其次，候选 harness 是由一个遵循预设脚本的模拟模型驱动的，而非通过下游任务中的真实模型驱动，因此评估是确定性的，且被评估的对象正是候选 harness 本身。 第三，候选 harness 作为一个黑箱，通过完整的脚本化会话进行端到端执行，其效果则从四个通道中读取。 这使得“被拒绝的操作必须不发生”这类约束条件能够逐条判定；并且，由于某个要求特定效果不出现的断言可能仅仅因为待测试功能从未运行而成立，因此此类测试用例配备了正向对照，以确认观察前提条件成立。 总而言之，Doc2Harness 是首个能够确定性评估模型开发 harness 能力的基准测试。

The protocol does not measure improvement based on behavioral feedback after the candidate harness is frozen.

Some test cases are built around the same feature: the single-variable expansion of § 2.3.3 derives several variants from one seed test case, and although the distance check discards candidates too close to their seed, the variants that remain are still correlated. A single defect can therefore cause correlated failures across these variants.

sents.zh: 某些测试用例围绕同一功能构建：第 2.3.3 节中的单变量扩展从一个种子测试用例派生出多个变体；尽管距离检查会排除与种子过于接近的候选项，但剩余的变体之间仍然存在相关性。

sents.en: A single defect can therefore cause correlated failures across these variants.
sents.zh: 因此，单个缺陷可能导致这些变体出现相关性的失败。

paragraphs.en: Doc2Harness is the first benchmark able to assess deterministically how well a model develops a harness. The build model under evaluation, operating inside a fixed builder harness, builds a complete candidate harness from a development document and a contract skeleton that declares interfaces only; a mock model then drives it through a preset script for each test case, and explicit assertions determine behavioral conformance.
paragraphs.zh: Doc2Harness 是首个能够确定性评估模型开发 harness 能力的基准测试。 正在评估的构建模型在固定的构建器 harness 内部运行，它根据一份开发文档和仅声明接口的合同骨架来构建一个完整的候选 harness；随后，一个模拟模型会按照每个测试用例的预设脚本驱动该 harness，并通过明确的断言来确定其行为是否符合要求。

paragraphs.en: Our experiments show that even the strongest model fails nearly half of the test cases, and that the failures are not random but concentrate on one implementation choice: whether the same functionality is split across several modules. We hope Doc2Harness will serve as a benchmark for measuring this class of construction ability.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的实验表明，即便是最强的模型，也有近一半的测试用例未能通过；而且这些失败并非随机发生，而是集中在一个实现选择上：是否将相同的功能拆分成多个模块。 我们希望 Doc2Harness 能够成为衡量这一类构建能力的基准。
